activeVersion.name: Settings gate picks up video regeneration requests
activeVersion.description: Video regeneration has no webhook of its own — it is seen only by Evaluate Video Approval, inside the video stage. A scene flagged after the batch walked past that gate had nobody left to pick it up, so the flag sat forever and the site showed a "Regenerating..." badge that never resolved. The final-settings gate now also watches Regenerează Video and sends the run back for another pass (one automatic bounce per scene per execution).
